source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
When this model is destroyed for the first time, roll one D6 as that phase ends. On a 2+, set it back up:

- with its full wounds
- as close as it can be to the spot where it was destroyed
- outside [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of every enemy unit
